title: Replication Data for: Involuntary resettlement for infrastructural development projects: Redesigning an evaluation framework on impacts on the population in host communities

descriptions: The datasets contain information which was collected for a PhD dissertation on the perceived impacts of involuntary resettlement due to a dam construction on the people in two host communities: The case study of Bui Dam in Ghana. It contains interviews transcripts, focus groups and questionnaires used to evaluate the perceived impacts of site implementation processes of dam-induced involuntary resettlement programmes and their governance on the population in host communities in Bui Dam, Ghana.
